purpose: Named items (concepts, formulas, models, skills) inside each of the 42 AQA 7132 specification sections, for the software item-level coverage check (ADR-0029, fast-path step 2).
rights_boundary: REFERENCE_ONLY: short Revision-authored labels that identify what AQA requires. No AQA wording is reproduced and none of this is teaching copy.
source: AQA 7132 subject content pages 3.1-3.10, checked 2026-09-30; Founder spot-check of 3.5 and 3.8 and influences/value sweep 2026-09-30

kinds.concept: a named idea or term; covered when a mapped node's teaching content names it
kinds.formula: a calculation; covered only when a mapped node has a quantitative method for it with a formula
kinds.model: a named model or framework; covered only when a mapped node lists it as a model, named facet, definition or method
kinds.skill: an analysis/evaluation skill; covered when a mapped node's teaching content addresses it

match_rule: Each 'match' entry is a lower-case phrase searched for in normalised node text (hyphens and apostrophes removed). Entries of 4 characters or fewer must match a whole word.

items.label: Types of business objective (profit, growth, survival, cash flow)
Revenue
items.aqa_convention: selling price × quantity sold

items.label: Total costs
items.aqa_convention: fixed costs + total variable costs

items.label: Profit
items.aqa_convention: total revenue - total costs

items.label: Market capitalisation
items.aqa_convention: shares in issue × current share price

items.label: Role of shareholders and why they invest
Effects of ownership on mission, objectives and decisions
Reasons for choosing or changing business form
Competition effects on costs and demand
Expected value
items.aqa_convention: sum of (probability × financial outcome) for each outcome of an option

items.label: Net gain
items.aqa_convention: expected value of an option - cost of that option

items.label: Influences on decisions (mission, ethics, environment, resources)
Market size
items.aqa_convention: total sales of all firms in the market, by value or volume

items.label: Market growth
items.aqa_convention: (market size this period - market size last period) / market size last period × 100

items.label: Market share
items.aqa_convention: firm sales / total market sales × 100 (by value or volume, used consistently)

items.label: Effect of price and income changes on revenue
Influences on choice of target market
Labour productivity
items.aqa_convention: output per period / number of employees

items.label: Unit cost (average cost)
items.aqa_convention: total costs / units of output

items.label: Capacity utilisation
items.aqa_convention: actual output / maximum possible output × 100

items.label: Benefits and difficulties of improving quality
Re-order quantity
items.aqa_convention: maximum inventory level - buffer inventory (read from an inventory control chart)

items.label: Return on investment
items.aqa_convention: return from the investment / cost of the investment × 100

items.label: Gross profit
items.aqa_convention: revenue - cost of sales

items.label: Operating profit
items.aqa_convention: gross profit - other operating expenses

items.label: Profit for the year
items.aqa_convention: operating profit - net finance costs - taxation

items.label: Variance analysis
items.aqa_convention: actual figure - budgeted figure, labelled favourable or adverse by its effect on profit

items.label: Break-even output
items.aqa_convention: fixed costs / contribution per unit

items.label: Margin of safety
items.aqa_convention: actual (or forecast) output - break-even output

items.label: Contribution per unit
items.aqa_convention: selling price per unit - variable cost per unit

items.label: Total contribution
items.aqa_convention: contribution per unit × units sold (equivalently revenue - total variable costs)

items.label: Effect of price, output and cost changes on break-even
Gross profit margin
items.aqa_convention: gross profit / revenue × 100

items.label: Operating profit margin
items.aqa_convention: operating profit / revenue × 100

items.label: Profit for the year margin
items.aqa_convention: profit for the year / revenue × 100

items.label: Using financial data for decisions and planning
Advantages, disadvantages and choice of finance source
Ways to improve profit and profitability
Difficulties of improving cash flow and profit
Influences on HR objectives and decisions
Labour turnover
items.aqa_convention: number of staff leaving in the period / average number of staff employed × 100

items.label: Labour productivity (HR)
items.aqa_convention: output per period / number of employees

items.label: Employee costs as a percentage of turnover
items.aqa_convention: employee costs / turnover (revenue) × 100

items.label: Labour cost per unit
items.aqa_convention: total labour costs / units of output

items.label: Using HR data in decisions and planning
Influences on and value of changing organisational design
Influences on choosing financial and non-financial motivation methods
Return on capital employed
items.aqa_convention: operating profit / capital employed × 100, where capital employed = total equity + non-current liabilities (equivalently total assets - current liabilities)

items.label: Current ratio
items.aqa_convention: current assets / current liabilities

items.label: Gearing
items.aqa_convention: non-current liabilities / (total equity + non-current liabilities) × 100

items.label: Payables days
items.aqa_convention: payables / cost of sales × 365

items.label: Receivables days
items.aqa_convention: receivables / revenue × 365

items.label: Inventory turnover
items.aqa_convention: cost of sales / average inventories held

items.label: Comparing ratios over time and with competitors
Using operations, HR and marketing data to assess performance
Interpreting UK and global economic data
Payback
items.aqa_convention: time taken for cumulative net cash inflows to repay the initial investment; months within a year = amount outstanding / net cash flow in that year × 12

items.label: Average rate of return
items.aqa_convention: average annual profit / initial investment × 100, where average annual profit = (total net cash inflows - initial investment) / years

items.label: Net present value
items.aqa_convention: sum of (net cash flow in each year × discount factor supplied) - initial investment

items.label: Influences on choice of markets and products
Competitive advantage and how to sustain it
Influences on choice of positioning strategy
Impact of growth or retrenchment on functional areas
Pressures to adopt digital technology and its value
Internal and external causes of change
Kotter and Schlesinger: reasons for resistance
Kotter and Schlesinger: methods of overcoming resistance
Reasons for and problems of changing culture
Leadership, communication and structure in implementation
Network analysis
items.aqa_convention: Use an activity-on-arrow network. Show each activity letter above its connecting arrow and its duration below. Show each event as a split circle with the event number on the left, earliest event time in the upper-right and latest event time in the lower-right.

items.label: Total float
items.aqa_convention: latest finish time - duration - earliest start time

convention_note: aqa_convention records a calculation or presentation convention a student should use for AQA 7132, in Revision's own words. convention_status 'to_confirm_against_aqa_mark_scheme' marks conventions where evidence is not yet sufficient to confirm the version recorded.
